data.narrative:
Persona AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $25M to date. The valuation universe comprises nine private robotics firms (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and one public comparable (277810.KQ), establishing a reference set of ten companies within the sector.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method proves applicable. This approach uses the $25M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement in frontier technology, yielding an implied valuation of $62M. The peer-median approach was excluded due to insufficient narrowly-filtered comparables—while ten same-sector peers exist, fewer than three satisfy both stage and valuation-tier alignment criteria, making that triangulation unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $53M to $72M, with a median estimate of $62M. This reflects a 15% discount and premium around the stage-progression point estimate. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this specific subsector and capital intensity profile, and the absence of directly comparable companies at identical stage and funding levels. A peer-median cross-check remains infeasible until additional Seed-stage robotics companies populate the dataset with sufficient detail.
